intro: Your ferry, transfers, car and two boat days, arranged through Original Senses, my partner in Athens. A deposit locks them in; the balance is due a month before you land.

transfers.title: All four island transfers
transfers.note: Santorini airport to Canaves Oia Suites, Canaves Oia Suites to Santorini port, Paros port to Cosme, and Cosme to Paros airport. Luxury vehicle with an English-speaking driver.

boats.title: Private sunset caldera cruise
boats.note: Five to six hours on a Lagoon 450 catamaran, BBQ cooked on board, wine, beer and soft drinks, snorkel gear and a fishing rod, hotel transfers both ways.

boats.title: Private full day to Antiparos, Despotiko & Panteronissia
boats.note: Eight hours on an Axopar 37 with an English-speaking captain, towels, snorkel gear, water toys, snacks and drinks.

photo.alt: An Axopar 37 with a covered cabin on calm water at sunset
photo.caption: The Axopar 37

cars.title: Car on Paros, DFSK 600 automatic
cars.note: Full cover, unlimited km, second driver and GPS, delivered to and collected from Cosme.

optional.title: Range Rover Evoque instead of the DFSK
optional.note: Same cover and delivery. Replaces the car above.

optional.title: Full day to Thirassia with a winery visit
optional.note: Eight hours on the Lagoon 450 with BBQ on board, a guided tasting of three whites at Mikra Thira winery and a Greek lunch in a traditional canava.

optional.title: Full day to Mykonos, Delos & Rhenia
optional.note: Axopar 37 with captain, plus a licensed guide and entry at Delos (€740).

optional.title: Half day to Antiparos instead of the full day
optional.note: Four hours on the same Axopar 37. Replaces the full day.

how: The deposit is set by Original Senses under their terms: 25% of transfers and experiences, the full ferry fare and 30% of private boat charters. The balance is due 30 days before you arrive. Boats and ferries go fast in high season, so it is worth locking them in early.
